claim: A 10 m computational output grid does not imply 10 m effective information for every covariate; resampling a coarser raster changes the grid representation but does not create new spatial detail.
conditions: Current inputs include Sentinel-2 NDVI at 10 m, SRTM terrain at about 30 m, MERIT Hydro at 92.77 m and CHIRPS at about 5566 m.
limitations: Effective resolution also depends on compositing, terrain derivatives, geolocation error and model smoothing.
recommended_action: Call 10 m the computational grid and publish each layer's asset ID, native resolution, resampling method and temporal aggregation.
not_allowed_action: Do not present every mapped pixel as an independent 10 m measurement.
